parsed_json.up: Select all IC50 activity rows for the human sodium-dependent dopamine transporter (CHEMBL238). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs (via assays.doc_id), compound_records (via activities.record_id), and compound_structures (via molecule_dictionary.molregno). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (coalesce DOI over PMID), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row.
